scope_note: The scorer maps dead_code (functions) to canonical dead_code judgments, so these 32 entries cover both Go buckets without duplicate entries. Existing ripgrep judgments are retained in earlier files.
release_note: Both legacy and active-view callgraph producer keys changed. Existing stores/views rebuild their callgraph evidence once; identical file content/language/current-producer keys then reuse the rebuilt parse blobs. The one-time cost is per file content, not per inspect.
